
The following figures present the annual exceedance probability for $S_a(T_n)$ for different structural periods and confidence intervals for the actual geotechnical conditions.
```{r}
Vs30_TARGET <- 250
TR_max <- 100000
AEP <- AEPTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1"]
```

::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) for PGA assuming site conditions with Vs30=%4d m/s" |> sprintf(Vs30_TARGET) 
#| label: fig-AEP.pga.site.docx
# This section requires to build first html output
# PNG files are generated during the html rendering
FILE <- file.path("png/fig-AEP.pga.site.png.png")
knitr::include_graphics(path=FILE, dpi = DPI)
```

:::

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills .content-visible when-format="html" unless-format="revealjs"}

### Sa(0) (PGA), all quantiles

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) for %s assuming site conditions with Vs30=%4d m/s" |> sprintf("PGA",Vs30_TARGET) 
#| label: fig-AEP.pga.site.html

p_TARGET <- c(0.16,0.50,"mean",0.84,0.90,0.95)
TR_max <- 100000
DATA <- AEP[p %in% p_TARGET & Tn==0 & TR<=TR_max,.(ID=p,X=Sa,Y=AEP)][order(X)]|> unique()

PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  plot.theme=highcharter::hc_theme_flat(),
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="spline",
  legend.layout="vertical",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  line.size=2.0,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="PGA [g]",
  group.legend="quantile",
  plot.save=FALSE,
  data=DATA) 


# Export PLOT for .docx rendering
FILE <- file.path("png/fig-AEP.pga.site.png")
DPI <- 150
WIDTH <- round(FACTOR_WIDTH * PAGE_WIDTH * DPI)
HEIGHT <- round(FACTOR_HEIGHT * PAGE_HEIGHT * DPI)
buildPlot::export(hc=PLOT, filename=FILE,width=WIDTH,height=HEIGHT,dpi=DPI,delay=DELAY)
# 
PLOT
```


### Sa(Tn), p=50%

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
p_TARGET <- 0.50
DATA <- AEP[ p == p_TARGET & Tn>=0 & TR<=TR_max,.(ID=Tn,X=Sa,Y=AEP)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)

#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) for %s (p=%s) assuming site conditions with Vs30=%4d m/s" |> sprintf("Sa(Tn)","mean",Vs30_TARGET) 
#| label: fig-AEP.mean.site.html
#| column: body-outset-right
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="vertical",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  line.size=2.0,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="PGA [g]",
  group.legend="Tn [s]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
